FEATURE_PROCESSING_TIME_BANNER_MESSAGE:
The processing time for Notification Applications and Victim Travel Fund Applications is currently 4 to 8 weeks. We kindly ask that you refrain from submitting another application as it creates additional administrative work.

If you require a more immediate response, please call the VSU at (604) 660-0316 or 1-(877)-315-8822 (toll free). Our hours are 8:30am to 4:30pm Monday to Friday (excluding weekends and statutory holidays). If you reach our voicemail, please leave a message and a VSU staff member will contact you in 24 to 48 business hours where possible.

Thank you,
VSU
